stem: ![](asset:P000476-stem-1) A collar 'B' of mass 2 kg is constrained to move along a horizontal smooth and fixed circular track of radius 5m. The spring lying in the plane of the circular track and having spring constant 200 N/m is undeformed when the collar is at 'A'. The other end of the spring is fixed 7 m from A, on the line through A and the centre of the track. If the collar starts from rest at B the normal reaction exerted by the track on the collar when it passes through 'A' is:

assets.alt: A circle of radius 5 m with top B, right-hand point C and bottom D. A spring fixed to a wall 7 m from the circle's left-hand point A is attached at its other end to a bead at B.
